text: Almost entirely fatty breasts (ACR breast density a).
No mammographic evidence of extracapsular implant rupture.
Stable postlumpectomy changes in the right breast upper outer quadrant with architectural distortion, skin thickening and dystrophic calcifications at the surgical site.
Biopsy marker clip in the left breast at 6 o'clock, posterior depth, at the site of a prior benign biopsy.
Stable focal asymmetry in the left breast lower inner quadrant.
Benign-appearing intramammary lymph node in the left breast upper outer quadrant.
